title: Learning to Prove, Not Just to Answer: Reinforcement Learning from Formal Verification for Natural-Language Logical Reasoning
abstract: arXiv:2609.37203v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed for natural-language logical reasoning, where the final answer is easy to check but the proof behind it is not. In natural-language logical reasoning, an intermediate conclusion should follow from its premises, and the resulting derivation should support the final answer. Existing methods lack machine-checkable verification of intermediate conclusions and answer-supporting proof dependencies, so they may assign credit to invalid or answer-irrelevant steps. We propose Proof-R1, an RL framework from formal verification that trains LLMs to construct verifiable proofs for natural-language logical reasoning. Proof-R1 admits a generated conclusion into the verified proof state only when the corresponding reasoning action satisfies the proof obligations through UNSAT-based machine-checkable formal verification. translated_title: 学习证明，而非仅仅回答：面向自然语言逻辑推理的基于形式化验证的强化学习
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）正被越来越多地应用于自然语言逻辑推理任务，在这类任务中，最终答案容易检验，但其背后的证明过程却难以验证。在自然语言逻辑推理中，中间结论应当由其前提推导得出，且由此形成的推理链条应当能够支持最终答案。现有方法缺乏对中间结论以及支持答案的证明依赖关系的机器可检验验证，因此可能会对无效或与答案无关的推理步骤给予奖励。我们提出了 Proof-R1，一个源自形式化验证的强化学习框架，用于训练大语言模型为自然语言逻辑推理构建可验证的证明。Proof-R1 仅当相应的推理动作通过基于 UNSAT 的机器可检验形式化验证、满足证明义务时，才将生成的结论纳入已验证的证明状态。Proof-R1 还会恢复支持答案的依赖闭包，以追踪证明的来源。
tldr: 该论文提出 Proof-R1 强化学习框架，利用基于 UNSAT 的机器可检验形式化验证，训练大语言模型为自然语言逻辑推理构建可验证证明，确保每个中间结论有效并真正支持最终答案。
en_tdlr: Proof-R1 is a reinforcement learning framework that leverages UNSAT-based, machine-checkable formal verification to train LLMs to construct verifiable proofs for natural-language logical reasoning, ensuring every intermediate conclusion is valid and supports the final answer.
